title: NoSQL
description: MongoDB and Memcached: operations, latency, connections, cache memory and evictions. Opened for containers labelled container.type=nosql.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Containers seen by cAdvisor in the last minute.

targets.expr: count(time() - container_last_seen{name=~"$container", name!="", container_label_container_type=~"nosql"} < 60) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM kills (24h)
panels.description: Killed by the kernel for using more memory than the limit.

panels.title: Memory vs limit
panels.description: Highest working set vs memory limit among the containers. Empty when none has a limit.

panels.title: Cache used
panels.description: WiredTiger cache. Near 100% = reads hit the disk.

panels.title: Latency by operation (avg)
panels.description: reads, writes, commands: average time per operation.

panels.title: Query efficiency: scanned vs returned
panels.description: Many docs scanned for few returned = queries without a fitting index (collection scans).

panels.title: Evictions/s
panels.description: Items dropped to make room: the cache is too small.
